adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `GroupsController#members` to always apply pagination with `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `members = ...limit(limit).offset(offset)`, whereas previously only `automatic?` groups were limited/offset and non-automatic groups returned the full member list. This is a real, diff-grounded behavior/API change that can silently truncate results for callers not updated to paginate (though the new response includes `meta.total/limit/offset` to support paging). It’s a compatibility concern rather than an internal correctness defect given the frontend was updated to call `findMembers()` and handle pagination.
